statement: No peer input can halt a Runtime: malformed, stale or racing input is refused, and only a broken local invariant halts. The Quint cell holds the Entity part only: a refused peer frame is a value and never halts the Entity (refusalNeverHaltsTest, no_peer_halt); the Runtime's halt taxonomy (malformed or racing input is refused, only a broken local invariant halts) is a comment in runtime.qnt, not a modelled property.

layers.contract: n/a: what a Runtime does with a peer input is off-chain; the chain halts nothing of the Runtime
